# Source Serif 4

Unmodified Adobe Source Serif 4 variable TrueType fonts in WOFF2 format, release **4.005R**. The source files `WOFF2/VAR/SourceSerif4Variable-{Roman,Italic}.ttf.woff2` and `LICENSE.md` are from [Adobe's tagged distribution](https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-serif/tree/4.005R). Distributed with [their SIL Open Font License](OFL.txt). Both weights and optical sizes are variable. These local assets do not contact a font service.
